title: Shenzhen: A New Breed of Intellectual Property (Part 3) | Future Cities | WIRED
summary: Part 3 of WIRED's Future Cities series on Shenzhen. It examines how attitudes toward patents and intellectual property differ from the West, and how shanzhai (copycat) manufacturing created an ecosystem of rapid iteration and distribution.
why: HN commenters point to it as a snapshot of Shenzhen's hardware and IP culture, including counterfeit electronics and fast iteration.

quote.text: A shoutout to a new video series from WIRED on Shenzhen.
